question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Soporific**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Stimulating**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Soporific"** means something that tends to induce drowsiness or sleep. (नींद लाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor's lecture was so soporific that many students struggled to stay awake.
 
 
 
• **"Stimulating"** refers to something that arouses excitement, interest, or activity, often having an invigorating effect. (उत्तेजक)
 
 
• **Example:** The stimulating conversation kept everyone engaged well past midnight.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'soporific'** is **'stimulating'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Stimulating)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Drowsy** (नींद से भरा हुआ): Feeling sleepy or lethargic.
 
 
• **Example:** After a heavy meal, John felt drowsy and decided to take a nap.
 
 
 
• **Sleep-inducing** (नींद लाने वाला): Causing or promoting sleep, similar to soporific.
 
 
• **Example:** The sound of rain can have a sleep-inducing effect on some people.
 
 
 
• **Sedative** (शांत करने वाली दवा): A substance or drug that calms or reduces excitement and induces sleep.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed a mild sedative to help the patient relax before surgery.
 
 

37:T643,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
